method: Fetched https://www.etsy.com/your/shops/me/stats/listings/<id>?channel=etsy-retail&start_date=2026-09-15&end_date=2026-09-21&date_range=custom via the authenticated Chrome session (fetch() from a Shop Manager page) and parsed the JSON Etsy embeds in the page HTML: the 'Search terms' horizontal_line_chart entries (label, value, segmented_values Internal/External), the 'Traffic sources' donut entries, and the Visits / Items Sold / Revenue line_chart total_string. Etsy exposes no API for shop stats. 36 requests, sequential, ~0.5s apart (faster than the pacing used for the later ads pass; noted in the pull note).
raw_note: Experiment slice, not the series file: it carries the same fields as the this-year capture plus a per-day series for Visits / Items Sold / Revenue. Deliberately named with a -since-day0 variant so scripts/ingest-pulls.py's LISTING_STATS_RE does not read it as a second this-year capture.
